# Marina Harbor Detox

> Marina Harbor Detox is a private, licensed drug and alcohol detox and residential treatment center in San Francisco, California, offering medically supervised detox, residential inpatient care, dual diagnosis treatment and aftercare planning.

Address: 289 Marina Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94123. Admissions phone: 1-866-525-3026 (24/7). Email: info@marinaharbordetox.com. Licensed by the California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS License #380106BP).

Content on this site is general information, not medical advice. In an emergency call 911; for a mental health or substance use crisis, call or text 988.
